newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Pilot survives Comoros air crash.
newsitem.headline: Pilot survives Comoros air crash.

text.p: The captain of the hijacked Ethiopian Airlines Boeing 767 that crashed into the sea off the Comoro Islands on Saturday was among the at least 25 survivors, Ethiopian Airlines officials said.

The officials said the plane, hijacked between Addis Ababa and its first scheduled stop in the Kenyan capital Nairobi, ran out of fuel and ditched into the sea while attempting to land at Moroni airport.
Unfavourable weather conditions over the sea some one kilometre (mile) from the airport where the plane crashed had hampered emergency services, they said.
There were up to 178 passengers and crew aboard the plane.
